info.description:
A database-first music streaming API on PostgreSQL 18. Add `?lens=1` to any request to see the SQL it ran, or `?lens=plan` for execution plans too.

Sign in with `POST /api/auth/login` and send the token it returns as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Every demo account's password is `vamusic`.
info.title: VaMusic API
